coverage_summary.note_vs_older_material: The website list adds Czech Republic, Austria, Finland, Israel, Egypt and the Taiwan domestic network compared with the 2022 deck map, and drops the UK and Qingdao. The website is the authority.

build_notes.map_regions: Five tabs: AMERICAS · EUROPE AREA · MIDDLE EAST / AFRICA · ASIA · OCEANIA — KAO MING's own grouping.
build_notes.multi_agent_countries: Canada, Belgium, France, Russia, India, Japan, China and Taiwan each have more than one agent. The map marker must expand to a list, not a single card.
build_notes.domestic_flag: Taiwan entries carry "domestic": true. Decide with sales whether they appear on the international site; default to hiding them on /en and showing them on /zh-tw.
build_notes.rfq_link: Every agent card gets a 'Request a quote through this representative' action that pre-fills the RFQ with country and agent.
build_notes.crm_alignment: This structure matches the agent registry in the KAO MING CRM project — the same records should eventually feed both.
